title: Music Video Maker
pitch: A song with your words, one character, seven directed shots, cut on the beat: a 30 to 45 second music video.
why: The song comes first and the picture follows it. Music 3 sings as long as the lyrics last, so the words set the length. Klein keeps one character through every keyframe, H3 moves each frame with its own camera move, and the edit is measured from the song: tempo, beats, its loudest section, then loudness normalized.

fields.label: Your lyrics, with [verse] and [chorus] on their own lines. About 6 seconds a line
fields.default:
[intro]

[verse]
Last train leaving, the lights burn low
Salt on the window, and nowhere to go
I kept your coat and the words you gave
I left the rest at the edge of the day
[pre-chorus]
And the dark rolls on, and the rails still sing
[chorus]
Take me to the gold line, take me to the sea
Every mile of midnight is a mile closer to me
Take me to the gold line, hold the morning near
I can see the city, I can see it clear
[verse]
Moon on the desert, silver and wide
Nobody's waiting on the other side
[chorus]
Take me to the gold line, take me to the sea
Every mile of midnight is a mile closer to me
Take me to the gold line, hold the morning near
I can see the city, I can see it clear
[outro]

tips: Original lyrics only. Write enough of them: Music 3 stops when the words run out.
Every tag on its own line, no numbers on the tags, identical choruses: the owner's rules from his music video maker.
Every shot renders from the same character frame, never from the last frame before it: identity falls with each chained segment.
These are story shots. Lip-synced singing shots (H3 with the song locked into its audio) are in the owner's earlier studio and not in this chain yet.

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: The song
raw_steps.prompt:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 104. key is D, and scale is minor. Cinematic indie pop.
Global Emotional Progression: A quiet guitar and voice opening grows through a rising pre-chorus into a wide, soaring chorus with full drums and strings.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: {world}.
Sonics & Production Profile: Warm, wide and cinematic, close vocal, deep low end, steady drums from the first chorus.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A (Female), warm and clear with a slight breath.
Vocal Style: Intimate in the verse, open and strong in the chorus.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: Soft stacked harmonies on the chorus.
Vocal FX: Light hall reverb and a short delay on line ends.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: Picked electric guitar with tremolo, piano and a steady kick.
Secondary: Strings and a warm synth pad that rise into the chorus.
Groove & Foundation Progression: A clear 104 BPM pulse from the first bars, full drums on the chorus.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Swells and cymbal rises into each chorus.
